body.p: , after , , , , , , . src/xslt_lower_control.c (rule view sxml_xslt_instruction_rules_control, one line in src/xslt_lower.c's list), tests/xslt_lower_control_test.c; no IR kind, no evaluator change, no public header.

item.p: Reused kinds (): xsl:if (with 4.0 then/else), choose and switch are CONDITIONAL chains, each later test lowered in the previous else branch; switch coerces the select value to one xs:anyAtomicType and compares each test value by "=" (8.3); xsl:for-each is a MAP whose body is the sequence constructor with a SLOTS focus, separator a text node guarded by position() lt last() (7.1.1); xsl:try is TRY_CATCH, errors tokens as name tests, the nine $err: variables pushed as LOOKUPs of the details slot (stack-trace and additional are ()), the try body the children before xsl:catch (xsl:catch gives () where it stands).

Variable bindings (9.3, 9.4): one procedure for xsl:variable, iterate xsl:param and xsl:with-param, and global initializers: select, else content (a document node unless "as" or a disqualifying child), else "" (or () with "as"); "as" coerces with XTTE0570 (a TRY_CATCH mapping XPTY0004) for variables and the TEMPLATE_PARAMETER role (XTTE0590) for parameters. A local xsl:variable is a LET in the sequence constructor's block and a scope entry until it ends ().

xsl:iterate (7.2) is fn:scan(input, state, closure): no recursion (), 100,000 items in a unit test. The state is an array [control, output, parameters...]; the closure (every visible variable captured, ; the size captured only when the body reads last()) unpacks the parameters, runs the body with focus (item, position, size), and reads the last item of its value: an iteration marker {Q{XSLT}iterate: [0, (), values...]} from xsl:next-iteration or {..: [1, value]} from xsl:break gives the next state, anything else keeps the parameters. After a break the remaining items return the state without output. The result is the states' outputs, then xsl:on-completion (focus absent, final parameters) unless a break happened. XTSE3120 (tail position, checked on the AST), XTSE3130, XTSE0670, XTSE0580, XTSE3125.

8.5: two internal native rows (as merge-text-nodes): and remove-deemed-empty (arrays flattened on an explicit stack). where-populated filters its content; a sequence constructor with on-empty/on-non-empty children (skipped by lower_child, a hook in src/xslt_lower.c pushes sxml_xslt_lowering_call_conditional_content at its end) is if (vacuous(R)) then on-empty-or-R else (children with each on-non-empty's value in place), each lowered in its branch with the variables before it in scope; XTSE0010 for an on-empty not last.

xsl:message, xsl:assert (23): the body is a document node of the select value and the content (TRY_CATCH: a body that cannot be built is an empty document, the transformation does not fail); the internal row xslt-message hands it to the trace sink as an XSLT_MESSAGE event with is_terminating and the code; terminate (an AVT, fixed or compared when evaluated) then raises fn:error(code, string(body), body). error-code: EQName or lexical QName, resolved while lowering, or by the row error-code with the instruction's namespaces as a map constant; an invalid one is the default (XTMM9000, XTMM9001). Assertions are always enabled.

Globals (9.5, 9.11): sxml_xslt_lowering_declare_global_variables before the main function (one per name by import precedence, XTSE0630; declared in every static context) and _add_global_variables after: initializers of arity 0 with the context global () as fixed focus, wrappers in dependency order (references in the declaration's expressions, explicit-stack DFS: XTDE0640 for a cycle, XPST0008 for a self-reference), a required xsl:param raises XTDE0050. The main function reserves its context slot when there are globals; callers pass absent global slots (as the XQuery tests). Static parameters are recomputed from their select (the AST keeps no static value).

Others: xsl:fork is its content; xsl:evaluate its xsl:fallback children or XTDE3175 (sxml claims no dynamic evaluation, ; a real one needs a nested evaluation, not done). xsl:for-each with xsl:sort is UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE until 4.9 (which can sort the input atom before the MAP). Deviations: 's missing zero-length text nodes change on-empty-113/114 and message-0304; dependencies through functions and templates are not seen.

Measured with a scratch harness (each case's initial template, or its match="/" template, through sxml_xslt_lower_initial_template; xml, error and string assertions): of 181 runnable cases of choose, for-each, iterate, try, switch, where-populated, on-empty, on-non-empty, message, evaluate, assert and decl-variable, 105 pass (before: none of these instructions lowered); most of the rest need apply-templates or template parameters ('s driver path, 4.15), stylesheet functions (4.10, 4.12) or current-date in the harness, 52 have XPath assertions.
